Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(ci\): update pnpm version to match GitHub Actions

Updates packageManager field from pnpm@8.15.0 to pnpm@9.15.4 to resolve
version mismatch error in CI/CD pipeline. GitHub Actions workflows were
configured for pnpm v9 but package.json specified v8.15.0, causing all
CI jobs to fail during pnpm setup step.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(ci\): remove pnpm version from workflows, use package.json

Removes explicit pnpm version specification from GitHub Actions workflows
to prevent version mismatch errors. The pnpm/action-setup@v4 will now
automatically read the version from the packageManager field in
package.json \(pnpm@9.15.4\).

Updated workflows:
- ci.yml
- deploy-web.yml
- release.yml

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(ci\): add pgvector extension and remove typecheck task

1. Use pgvector/pgvector:pg16-alpine image instead of postgres:16-alpine
   to provide the required pgvector extension for the database schema

2. Remove non-existent typecheck task from lint job - this task is not
   defined in turbo.json and was causing CI failures

These changes resolve the remaining CI failures:
- Database migration error: extension "vector" is not available
- Lint error: Could not find task `typecheck` in project

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
